description: Honeycomb trigger fired to a Slack recipient: trigger name, the evaluated result against its threshold, and links to the trigger and the query result.
provenance: Honeycomb docs: Triggers (Slack is a recipient type; notifications link to the trigger and the triggering query result) and the trigger template variables (.Name, .ID, .URL = trigger page, .Result.URL = query result, .Operator such as 'greater than or equal to', .Threshold, .Alert.Status TRIGGERED / OK, .Alert.Timestamp RFC 3339). Trigger URLs are https://ui.honeycomb.io/<team>/environments/<env>/datasets/<dataset>/triggers/<id> (environment-wide triggers omit the dataset). The native Slack wording is not published; reconstructed from those variables.

attachments.title: Triggered: Checkout error rate
attachments.text:
